events.text_en: The founder of Thải Chi Cốc grows a gourd on her own vine and cures it with lingzhi spores; herbs kept in it do not wilt.
A herb-picker of Thải Chi carries a girl of four out of the Hà Đê flood in his basket. She will be the valley's mistress.
The youngest master of Lăng Tiêu Các walks into Thải Chi Cốc with a bronze censer and a coal from the fire that burned his pavilion.
By lamplight in Thải Chi's lower field, the valley-mistress treats Lạc Hà raiders wounded at Đào Sa and sends them home.
